details: The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, a significant bill aimed at establishing a comprehensive regulatory framework for cryptocurrencies in the US, failed to advance in the Senate. This legislative setback has been noted as a disappointment for the crypto industry, particularly impacting tokens sensitive to US regulatory status. The vote garnered fewer than the 60 votes required, with several negotiating Democrats opposing due to unresolved ethics provisions.
title: US Senate Blocks CLARITY Act Crypto Bill

details: The Federal Reserve unanimously voted to raise its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to a target range of 3.75%-4%. This was largely anticipated by markets, and cryptocurrencies, including Ethereum, showed resilience, suggesting the decision was priced in. Goldman Sachs now anticipates another rate hike in October, shifting from an earlier call for a pause.
title: Federal Reserve Raises Interest Rates by 25 Basis Points

details: Ethereum (ETH) gained 1.7% over the last 24 hours, reclaiming $2,431 despite the Federal Reserve's rate hike and the CLARITY Act's failure. Crypto-native traders show renewed buy-side activity, as indicated by exchange outflows and perpetual futures. However, institutional demand appears weak, with continued outflows from US spot Ethereum ETFs. Analysis suggests resistance at $2,500 and potential for movement towards $2,000, while a close above $2,550 could signal a push to $3,000.
title: Ethereum Shows Resilience Amid Market Headwinds

details: Bitcoin's price rebounded from a low near $74,900 but is currently facing a key test around the $77,000-$77,200 resistance level. The cryptocurrency experienced a minor dip following the news of the CLARITY Act's failure but has since stopped the bleeding. Market data indicates a mixed outlook with some oscillators showing negative and neutral readings.
title: Bitcoin Rebounds from Low, Faces $77K Resistance

details: Chainflip announced it would reset TRON USDT provider balances to zero following a $736,000 exploit. While providers retain a separate on-chain record of their owed funds, the exact timing for repayment has not yet been disclosed by Chainflip.
title: Chainflip to Reset TRON USDT Balances After $736K Exploit

details: Avalanche's upcoming Helicon upgrade, scheduled for September 22, will significantly reduce validator lockup periods from 14 days to just 48 hours. This upgrade also introduces validator auto-renewal, although it will make securing full-cycle rewards more challenging.
title: Avalanche Helicon Upgrade to Cut Validator Lockups

details: Circle has officially launched its Arc mainnet, aiming to gain a competitive advantage for USDC's utility in the cryptocurrency ecosystem. The network simplifies payments and fees by using a single USDC balance.
title: Circle Launches Arc Mainnet to Enhance USDC Utility

details: Solana has successfully tripled its transaction size, demonstrating improved network scalability as major upgrades coincide with record network activity. This enhancement addresses growing demand and boosts the platform's capacity.
title: Solana Triples Transaction Size Amid Major Upgrades
